firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player at random: place all players' unification tiles face down, mix them, and pick one. Play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: Each player takes the unification tile bearing their own dynastic symbol during setup.
internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rulebook from Fantasy Flight Games' CDN (https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/filer_public/bf/e1/bfe1ae7d-d41c-44d4-910b-86cd59324b38/kn25_rulebook_web.pdf), SHA-256 e6484d330ff7c7d020bf17d9da5f48257dece9886bdbfa4b2c1b9d0fec1da9d6, and extracted the text of all 16 pages. Page 4, Setup: choose a starting player at random by placing all of the players' unification tiles with the dynastic symbols facedown, mixing them, and picking one; play proceeds clockwise.
